scenario: Errors-as-values schema availability per LERR.1.2 — CallError is a builtin schema injected when referenced in a rule LHS. Rules can pattern-match on code and corr slots. The engine does not synthesise CallError; the integrator asserts it (thin-verb per IDSP.6 / LCRS.3.1). Compile-side pin: program with CallError in LHS compiles.
rules_ds:
service svc.op:
    kwarg corr: String
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call svc.op nocooldown corr: "c1"

rule handle_error:
    CallError e where e.code == "timeout"
->
    log critical "timeout"
